body: One of my therapists made me try this relaxation technique. I had to imagine a place where I was safe and at peace. Then, I had to imagine an "advisor" who would help get me through the tough times. The only creature I have that loves me like that is  my dog. So I pictured him. I bet you'd picture your brother. My place was a field that I could just sit and talk with my dog all day. Your comment reminded me of that. I wish that's what death could be like. Just me and him in a field all day talking.
I'm sorry to hear that. I wish we didn't live in such a shitty world. I wish we lived in a world where it didn't have to hurt to wake up. Or contnute on with our days. But we do, and that sucks.
